Form error summary

Source: R/form-message.R
shad_form_summary.Rd

A role="alert" box listing field errors with anchor links to each field. Place it above the form and move focus to it on a failed submit. Populated by hand, or via shad_validator()'s bind_summary().

Usage

shad_form_summary(
  id,
  title = "Please fix the errors below",
  errors = NULL,
  class = NULL
)

Arguments

id

Element id (targeted by the validator).

title

Summary heading (e.g. "2 fields need attention").

errors

Optional named character vector c(field_id = "message"); each becomes a link to #field_id.

class

Extra CSS classes.

Value

A form-summary tag.

See also

Other shadshiny forms: shad_field_group(), shad_field_separator(), shad_fieldset(), shad_form_counter(), shad_form_message(), shad_rules, shad_validator(), update_shad_form_field()

Examples

shad_form_summary(
  "errs", "2 fields need attention",
  errors = c(email = "Email is not valid", pw = "Password too short")
)
#> <div class="shad-form-summary" id="errs" role="alert">
#>   <div class="shad-form-summary__title">
#>     <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M12 8v4M12 16h.01"/></svg>
#>     2 fields need attention
#>   </div>
#>   <ul class="shad-form-summary__list">
#>     <li>
#>       <a href="#email">Email is not valid</a>
#>     </li>
#>     <li>
#>       <a href="#pw">Password too short</a>
#>     </li>
#>   </ul>
#> </div>
